# Gem Experience

> Gem Experience is a coloured-gemstone jewellery house. Tanzanite and other stones of the East African belt are chosen at the source in Tanzania, cut in the house's own workshop and finished by hand as Fine Jewellery and one-of-a-kind High Jewellery, with ateliers in Dubai, Jaipur and Arusha.

Prices are not published: Fine Jewellery and High Jewellery are quoted on request, and every piece is made to order. Enquiries are answered by an adviser, usually within two working days.

## Shop

- [High Jewellery](https://gem-experience.com/high-jewellery/): one-of-a-kind pieces, each built around a single stone, quoted privately.
- [Fine Jewellery](https://gem-experience.com/fine-jewellery/): 268 pieces in 12 collections (Bloom, Safar, Dazzle, Entwine, Dome, Tide, Swirl, Spectrum, Flare, Royal Starling, Multi Colour, Shamsa Fine).
- [Gifts](https://gem-experience.com/gifts/): pieces chosen to be given, with a handwritten card.
- [Request a quotation](https://gem-experience.com/quotation/) · [Book a private viewing](https://gem-experience.com/appointment/)

## The house

- [The House](https://gem-experience.com/the-house/): stones chosen at the source in Tanzania, cut in the house's own workshop, ateliers in Dubai, Jaipur and Arusha.
- [Lookbook](https://gem-experience.com/lookbook/): High Jewellery and Fine Jewellery photographed as worn.

## Fine Jewellery collections

- Bloom: Cycles of life. Every person blooms differently. (Mint garnet · Aquamarine · Tanzanite · Pink spinel · White gold)
- Safar: A journey through time. Designed with Shantanu Garg. (Designed with Shantanu Garg)
- Dazzle: Tame the brilliance. (Tanzanite · Aquamarine · Pink spinel · Mint garnet · Spessartite · Tsavorite · White gold)
- Entwine: Branches that grow and intertwine. (Tanzanite · Tourmaline · Aquamarine · Morganite · Mint garnet · Malaya garnet · White gold)
- Dome: Celestial forms, suspended in space. (Pink spinel · Spessartite · Tanzanite · Tsavorite · Rhodolite · White, rose and yellow gold)
- Tide: The rhythm of the ocean: graceful, constant and ever in motion. (Flowing contours · rhythm of the wave)
- Swirl: Fluid, playful, and intuitively balanced motion. (Soft rotations · layered curves)
- Spectrum: Set with aquamarine, rose rhodolite, mint garnet, tanzanite and tsavorite, with diamonds. (Aquamarine · Rose rhodolite · Mint garnet · Tanzanite · Tsavorite · White and rose gold)
- Flare: Set with tanzanite, aquamarine, pink spinel, tourmaline and spessartite, with diamonds. (Tanzanite · Aquamarine · Pink spinel · Tourmaline · Spessartite · Rhodolite · White, rose, gold and gold-14kt gold)
- Royal Starling: Set with mint garnet, tsavorite, tanzanite and pink spinel, with diamonds. (Mint garnet · Tsavorite · Tanzanite · Pink spinel · White, rose and yellow gold)
- Multi Colour: Set with pink spinel, aquamarine, spessartite, mint garnet and tanzanite, with diamonds. (Pink spinel · Aquamarine · Spessartite · Mint garnet · Tanzanite · Tsavorite · White and yellow gold)
- Shamsa Fine: Inspired by the sun: a study in incandescence and inner energy. (Tanzanite · Pink spinel · White and yellow gold)

## Gemstones

- [World of Preciousness](https://gem-experience.com/world-of-preciousness/): how a coloured stone is judged, and the gemstones of the East African belt.
- [Malaya Garnet](https://gem-experience.com/world-of-preciousness/malaya-garnet/): Found by local miners in the Umba River Valley in the 1990s: a garnet of exceptional fire, once an outcast, now a hidden gem.
- [Rhodolite](https://gem-experience.com/world-of-preciousness/rhodolite/): The rose garnet: a fusion of almandine and pyrope, carried as an amulet in Rome, Egypt and Greece, and mined in Tanzania&#x27;s Umba River Valley.
- [Spinel](https://gem-experience.com/world-of-preciousness/spinel/): The stone that spent six centuries in the Crown Jewels under the wrong name. Mahenge spinel from the East African belt: its colour, its hardness and its legends.
- [Tanzanite](https://gem-experience.com/world-of-preciousness/tanzanite/): A trichroic stone from one hill at the foot of Kilimanjaro, a thousand times scarcer than diamond. The legend, the colours and the rarity of tanzanite.
- [Tsavorite](https://gem-experience.com/world-of-preciousness/tsavorite/): The green garnet discovered in Tanzania in 1967, four times rarer than emerald. The discovery, the brilliance and the rarity of tsavorite.

## Client care

- [Frequently asked questions](https://gem-experience.com/faqs/)
  - How are Fine Jewellery pieces priced? Every piece is priced on the stone it is set with, so prices are given on request. Add a piece to your cart and place an enquiry, and an adviser will confirm the price before any payment is taken.
  - Can I include a personal message? Yes. Write it on the Gifts page, or from your bag, cart or checkout. The message is written by hand on a card and set inside the box.
  - Is there a charge for gift wrapping or the card? No. Every gift leaves the workshop boxed and ribboned, and the handwritten card is included at no charge.
  - Which stones and metals do you use? The collections are set with coloured stones including tanzanite, pink spinel, mint garnet, aquamarine, rhodolite, spessartite, morganite and Malaya garnet, alongside diamonds, in white, rose or yellow gold. Each…
  - How long can the message be? Up to 140 characters. Because the card is written by hand, three short lines fit comfortably.
  - Is the stone in my piece the one described? Yes. Every coloured stone is sourced and graded before it is set, so the carat weight and shape on the product page match the stone actually in the piece.
  - Can I change the message after placing my order? Yes. The message can be changed at any time before the piece ships. Contact us with your order number.
  - How long does delivery take? In-stock pieces ship within 5–7 working days. Delivery is insured worldwide, and a signature is required on arrival.
  - I am not sure what to choose. Can you help? The Gifts page gathers the pieces most often given, from pendants and studs to slim bracelets. For something more particular, speak to an adviser or book a private viewing.
  - Can I return a piece? Returns are accepted within 15 days on unworn, unaltered pieces in their original packaging. Resized or engraved pieces are final sale.
  - Can a ring be resized? Yes. Rings are resized, and necklaces and bracelets restrung, in our own workshop. Please allow two weeks.
  - How should I care for my jewellery? Store each piece separately in its fitted pouch, away from direct light and heat. Our workshop will clean and check any piece at any time, without charge.
  - Is there a guarantee? Every Fine Jewellery piece carries a lifetime guarantee against manufacturing defect.
  - Can I see a piece before I buy it? Yes. Book a private viewing and an adviser will take you through the pieces, or find the atelier nearest you.
- [Contact](https://gem-experience.com/contact/): contact@gem-experience.com
